set.body: Detection.supportFor scans every sample per event, O(events x samples); X6 measured a 368-502 ms detection step at 60k samples and 55-81 seconds at 600k on M3 Max/JDK25. Replace range discovery with binary searches over ordered sample timestamps or a correct ordered sweep. Preserve half-open support and failure operands/order, including irregular timestamps, empty support, invalid/outside events and restore/custom detection routes. Acceptance: generated-input comparison against the old quadratic scan as independent oracle; exact support, errors and serialized public results where available; existing detection, recording-plan, EyeLink and JVM/JS checks. On the declared pinned workload/runtime, measure max step, runner gap and cancellation latency against 100 ms for 60k samples, and retain the 600k workload to demonstrate scaling and disclose residual misses. Timing is qualification evidence, separate from deterministic tests; do not hide a miss with a smaller workload. Record revision and reproducible commands in docs/EXECUTION_RESPONSIVENESS.md.
